URL: https://cnbc.com/2026/11/23/ukraine-russia-warship-libya.html
Published: Mon 23 Nov 2026, 5:09 AM EST (10:09 GMT), by Sam Meredith
(Extracted article content)
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine used seven domestically made naval drones in the early hours of Sunday to sink the Russian corvette Merkury at Benghazi port, Libya. The ship was commissioned in 2023.
Zelenskyy said the operation also damaged the Russian dry cargo ship MV Angara, which he said Moscow used to transport weapons, and destroyed a Ka-27 military helicopter aboard the corvette.
Satellite images from Sunday showed the Merkury mostly underwater, having capsized.
The attack followed a suspected Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea on Saturday, and came less than a week after damage to the Crimea bridge.
Zelenskyy called the operation "exemplary." "Despite all the enemy's efforts to counter the attack, the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk." "We continue our operations in designated waters."
Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said information on the reports of attacks off Libya's coast would be provided by the Defense Ministry.
SBU: the attacks showed Russia's fleet and logistics "have no safe routes even far beyond the Black Sea."
UNSMIL expressed "serious concern": Libya "cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts." Called for an "immediate, independent and transparent investigation."
In March, Moscow's Transport Ministry accused Ukraine of attacking the LNG tanker Arctic Metagaz in a suspected sea drone attack in the Mediterranean between Libya and Malta.
